meta.name: How to Ruin Diwali
meta.description:
When overachieving perfectionist Mmabatho Nkomo meets her fiancé’s traditional Indian family for the first time, her desperate attempt to make a good impression goes badly wrong. She accidentally exposes her future father-in-law’s secret affair. With Diwali only days away, Mmabatho must navigate unfamiliar cultural territory and try to reunite the family she has torn apart — without creating even more chaos.

Complete series. On your server: S1 3/3

videos.title: Bang! Bang!
videos.overview: Doctor Mmabatho's first holiday with her fiance's family goes from celebration to catastrophe as one guest makes a shocking decree: Diwali is canceled.

videos.title: Sparks Fly!
videos.overview: Mmabatho calls in reinforcements and starts from scratch to launch Operation: Save Diwali — unaware that her parents have a scheme of their own.

videos.title: Love Reignited!
videos.overview: With Diwali hanging in the balance, the two families must confront painful truths to shine a light amid the darkness and embrace their future as one.
